items.title: Trump administration kicks out Cuban diplomat from US as tensions rise
items.brief: US Ambassador to the UN Mike Waltz said the Trump administration is ejecting a Cuban diplomat from the United States amid soaring tensions between Washington and Havana.

items.title: What caused the deadly train crash in Spain? What we know so far
items.brief: Scores of people were killed after two trains collided in Spain on Wednesday, in a crash that authorities say was caused by both computer system failure and apparent human error.

items.title: Manhunt for escaped Tennessee murder convict crosses state lines after the truck he stole is found abandoned in Illinois

items.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico expand lawsuit against Trump White House, citing continued ‘viewpoint discrimination’
items.brief: CNN, MS NOW and Politico have amended their lawsuit against President Donald Trump’s White House press ban, citing “continued retaliatory and viewpoint-discriminatory deprivation” by the Trump administration.

items.title: Flávio Bolsonaro says he will lead Brazil’s opposition in exile, after landing in US following election defeat
items.brief: Brazilian senator Flávio Bolsonaro has said he will lead his country’s opposition from the United States, where he arrived on Wednesday after fleeing Brazil following his defeat in Sunday’s presidential election.
